audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Forgiveness, confession, bodily distress, instruction, and joy.

verses.restored: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

familiar.text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.restored: Blessed is the human to whom YHWH does not count iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.

familiar.text: Blessed is the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.restored: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

familiar.text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

notes.title: Body and guilt language
notes.body: The psalm poetically links unacknowledged wrongdoing with bodily wasting. This must not be generalized into a claim that illness, disability, or chronic pain is caused by personal sin.

verses.restored: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

familiar.text: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.restored: I acknowledged my sin to thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions to YHWH; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

familiar.text: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.restored: For this shall every one that is godly pray to thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh to him.

familiar.text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.restored: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

familiar.text: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.restored: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

familiar.text: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

verses.restored: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near to thee.

familiar.text: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

verses.restored: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in YHWH, mercy shall compass him about.

familiar.text: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.restored: Be glad in YHWH, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Do not turn the psalm’s guilt/body imagery into a claim that illness or disability proves sin.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit. Preserve poetic parallelism, superscriptions, duplicate/parallel psalms, and significant Hebrew/Greek divergences rather than harmonizing them.
